mcqs.learning_point: लेखक के अनुभवों और दृष्टिकोण को समझना
mcqs.question: In "ल्हासा की ओर", how does the author's personal experience of the difficult terrain compare with his overall attitude toward nature?

options.A: He sees the terrain solely as an obstacle and expresses dislike for nature.
options.B: He regards the harsh terrain as a test of endurance, yet admires nature's beauty.
options.C: He ignores the terrain and focuses only on cultural aspects.
options.D: He describes the terrain humorously, showing indifference to nature.

mcqs.answer: He regards the harsh terrain as a test of endurance, yet admires nature's beauty.
mcqs.explanation: The passage describes the journey as physically demanding, testing the author's stamina, while simultaneously praising the scenic beauty of the mountains. This dual view matches option B; the other options misrepresent his attitude.

mcqs.question: Which feature most clearly illustrates the descriptive language used by the author in the passage?

options.B: Vivid sensory imagery that paints the landscape

mcqs.answer: Vivid sensory imagery that paints the landscape
mcqs.explanation: Descriptive language relies on concrete sensory details—visual, auditory, tactile images of mountains, rivers, and weather. The passage is rich in such imagery, making B correct; the other options are not characteristic of descriptive prose in this travelogue.

mcqs.question: Which of the following is a typical characteristic of a यात्रा‑वृत्तांत (travelogue) as seen in "ल्हासा की ओर"?

options.D: Absence of any personal feelings or reflections

mcqs.explanation: Travelogues are usually narrated in the first person, allowing the writer to share personal observations and feelings. Options B, C, and D describe styles not typical of a travelogue.

mcqs.learning_point: यात्रा के मार्ग और कठिनाइयों को समझना
mcqs.question: What does the author describe as the main difficulties encountered on the route to Lhasa?

options.A: The journey proceeds through flat plains without any obstacles
options.B: Steep mountain passes, narrow trails, and sudden river crossings
options.C: A straight, paved road with frequent rest houses
options.D: Travel by sea across a calm lake

mcqs.answer: Steep mountain passes, narrow trails, and sudden river crossings
mcqs.explanation: The text mentions climbing steep ascents, negotiating narrow mountain paths, and crossing swift rivers, highlighting the harsh physical challenges. Options A, C, and D do not match the described terrain.

mcqs.question: Which sentence best exemplifies the author's description of the natural environment?

options.A: ऊँचे पहाड़ों की चोटी पर बर्फ की चादर बिखरी हुई थी।
options.B: गाँव वाले शाम को गीत गाते थे।

mcqs.answer: ऊँचे पहाड़ों की चोटी पर बर्फ की चादर बिखरी हुई थी।
mcqs.explanation: Option A provides a vivid visual picture of the landscape, directly describing nature. Options B and C describe human activities, while D expresses a personal feeling, not a natural description.

mcqs.learning_point: स्थानीय जनजीवन और संस्कृति को समझना
mcqs.question: Which observation from the passage reflects the local people's way of life and culture?

options.A: सर्दियों में बर्फ़ीले पहाड़ों की चमक।
options.B: स्थानीय लोग शाम को पारम्परिक नृत्य करते हैं।
options.C: नई राजमार्गों ने यात्रा को आसान बना दिया।
options.D: पर्यटक विदेशी भोजन का आनंद ले रहे थे।

mcqs.answer: स्थानीय लोग शाम को पारम्परिक नृत्य करते हैं।
mcqs.explanation: Traditional evening dance is a cultural practice of the local community, directly illustrating their way of life. Options A and C describe physical or infrastructural aspects, while D focuses on tourists, not locals.

mcqs.learning_point: लेखक के अनुभवों और दृष्टिकोण को समझना
mcqs.question: Which excerpt best illustrates the author's personal experience and viewpoint during the trek?

options.A: ठंडी हवा ने यात्रा को सुखद बना दिया।
options.B: कठिन रास्ता मेरे धैर्य की परीक्षा ले रहा था, फिर भी मैं जीवंत महसूस कर रहा था।
options.C: मैंने स्थानीय लोगों को पूरी तरह नज़रअंदाज़ किया।
options.D: यात्रा बिल्कुल भी रोचक नहीं थी।

mcqs.answer: कठिन रास्ता मेरे धैर्य की परीक्षा ले रहा था, फिर भी मैं जीवंत महसूस कर रहा था।
mcqs.explanation: Option B captures both the hardship of the trail and the author's invigorated feeling, reflecting a nuanced perspective. Options A, C, and D either oversimplify or misrepresent his attitude.

mcqs.question: A student rewrites the sentence ‘घने जंगल की ठंडी हवा मेरे चेहरे को छू रही थी।’ Which revision best retains the descriptive quality of the original?

options.A: जंगल की हवा मेरे चेहरे को छूती है।
options.B: ठंडी हवा मेरे चेहरे को छू रही थी।
options.C: घने जंगल की ठंडी हवा मेरे चेहरे को धीरे‑धीरे छू रही थी, जैसे सर्दी की फुसफुसाहट।
options.D: मैं जंगल में चल रहा था।

mcqs.answer: घने जंगल की ठंडी हवा मेरे चेहरे को धीरे‑धीरे छू रही थी, जैसे सर्दी की फुसफुसाहट।
mcqs.explanation: Option C preserves the sensory detail (cold wind, dense forest) and adds a metaphor, maintaining the vivid, descriptive style. Options A and B lose context or detail, and D changes the focus entirely.
